premises.text: The modern retail environment weaponizes hardwired human impulses, so Americans waste 10-20% of disposable income on unwanted impulse buys
premises.evidence_span: Most of us in America are actually spending between 10 and 20% of our disposable income on these silly purchases we don't need, and most of the time don't even remember making

premises.text: Conventional personal-finance advice built on plans, budgets, and spreadsheets does not work
premises.evidence_span: you must create a plan, you must have a budget, you must stick to that financial diet, you must use spreadsheets and budgets. Well, look at their results. It doesn't work.

premises.text: Saving has to be redesigned to fit human nature rather than changing people to fit savings
premises.evidence_span: Instead of changing people or trying to to fit into savings, we've actually changed saving to fit into people.

premises.text: Users open an FDIC-insured, interest-bearing online piggy bank linked to any external checking account
premises.evidence_span: In doing so, they create an online piggy bank, a savings account that's FDIC-insured and interest-bearing.

premises.text: Users anchor their saving to personal goals they care about
premises.evidence_span: Then, they create goals. And a goal can be anything from an iPad, to a travel vacation, to paying down your student debt

premises.text: At the moment of impulse, the app moves the would-be purchase amount into savings and instantly rewards the saver
premises.evidence_span: throwing it back on the rack and not buying it, but have the amount she was just about to have spent be transferred automatically in that moment into her ImpulseSave savings account

premises.text: Optional social sharing turns saving into bragging that reinforces the behavior
premises.evidence_span: close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves. It's an aspect of bragging.

premises.text: ImpulseSave re-markets users' own goals back to them through email, progress updates, and behavior- and location-based push notifications
premises.evidence_span: We do that through email updates and progress updates. We do that through notifications. Push notifications based on your behavior. Push notifications based on your current location.

value.text: Saving money becomes as easy and instantly gratifying as spending it, so people actually save
value.evidence_span: ImpulseSave has actually made it just as easy and as instantly gratifying to save your money as it is to spend it
